title: Studio Operating Procedures, Quality Engineering & Release Cadence

core_principles: No unreviewed code or assets enter production: every change begins as an RFC specifying discipline, diff, and acceptance criteria.
Pre-flight invariant checking prevents known historical bugs before review.
Multi-disciplinary quorum reviews ensure systems, narrative, level, client, and QA agree before deployment.
modules.operational_rule: Staged RFCs must achieve consensus quorum and pass automated heuristic checks before compilation.

core_principles: Semantic versioning (SemVer) increments must reflect the scope of change: Major (platform architecture), Minor (new district/economy/quest), Patch (self-healing/bugfix).
Zero Potemkin progress: deliverables can only be marked VERIFIED if physical on-disk artifacts exist and pass validation.
Automated release packaging archives release notes, compiles runtime manifests, and shifts the studio horizon forward.
modules.operational_rule: Milestones only transition to VALIDATING and SHIPPED when all deliverables verify against live on-disk artifacts.
